what: The Zodiac Sign Calculator finds your Western zodiac (sun) sign and your Chinese zodiac animal and element from your date of birth.

Western signs follow the usual date ranges. The Chinese sign uses the real Lunar New Year date for your birth year, so people born in January or early February get the right animal. Descriptions are light-hearted and just for fun.
uses: See your sign, element and quality.
See your animal, element and yin or yang.
Get the right Chinese sign for dates before Lunar New Year.
Look up signs for friends and family.
tutorial: The first card shows the sign, its dates, element and quality and a short description.
The second card shows element and animal, the dates of that lunar year, and yin or yang.
The table lists all 12 Western signs with dates and elements.
Click "Copy my signs" to share them.
features: All 12 signs with dates, element and quality.
Uses your browser's Chinese calendar for the exact Lunar New Year.
Metal, Water, Wood, Fire or Earth.
Tells you if you were born at the edge of a sign.
Your birth date is not stored.

example.title: Worked example
example.text: Someone born on 15 January 1990 is a Capricorn. Lunar New Year 1990 was on 27 January, so they belong to the previous lunar year, 1989, which is the year of the Earth Snake. Someone born on 27 January 1990 is an Aquarius and a Metal Horse.

tips: If you were born in January or February, check the Lunar New Year note.
Born on a cusp day? Read both neighbouring signs for fun.
Older browsers without a Chinese calendar show an approximate sign near the new year.
Copy your signs and compare them with friends and family.
problems: Pick a full date of birth.
My Chinese sign differs from a website
Some sites go by 1 January or 4 February. This tool uses the actual Lunar New Year.
